sheet.summary: Sudden job transitions or salary disruptions do not pause contractual financial obligations such as home loan EMIs, rent, and school fees. Financial planning benchmarks indicate that maintaining six months of non-negotiable living expenses—split between sweep-in deposits and liquid mutual funds—acts as a critical safety cushion. For salaried Indian families, setting up an automated emergency allocation protects existing investments from distressed liquidation and prevents reliance on high-cost borrowing during an income shock.

topic.summary: Why six months of expenses in a liquid place matters, where to keep it (savings, sweep FD, liquid fund), how a family builds it in a year, what not to touch it for.
